connections.title: Google Drive MCP tool names (search_files, get_file_metadata, create_file, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to GOOGLE_DRIVE_MCP_URL with GOOGLE_DRIVE_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. The eight Google Drive MCP tool names are exposed as aliases next to the canonical google-drive.<operation> names.

connections.title: Google Drive REST client (base URL override)
connections.instructions: Point your Drive client's root URL at GOOGLE_DRIVE_API_BASE_URL so requests reach <base>/drive/v3/... and <base>/upload/drive/v3/..., and send GOOGLE_DRIVE_ACCESS_TOKEN as `Authorization: Bearer`. Test processes only; OAuth scopes and consent are not emulated; uploads must use uploadType=media with a UTF-8 body.
